geeklist.title: Amazon No Longer Allows Used Board Games Part 5 - Closed
geeklist.description:
[b]Amazon No Longer Allows Used Board Games Part 5[/b]
So Amazon is no longer allowing people to see used board games on their site. My loss is your gain. All games start at either $1 or $5. This is the second of about 10 Auctions to divest myself of used games on Amazon.
I will close the auction late on Saturday 12/06/25
1. All games will have a soft reserve. You can bid below it, but I will likely not part with the game below the soft reserve.
2. Please bid in whole dollar amounts.
3. I will run all items that sell through the marketplace so BGG will get its 3% cut.
4. I ship predominately via USPS. Heavier items may go Fed Ex or UPS if they are cheaper. I use Pirate Shipping and any savings in postage is passed along to you. You can also send me a postage label if you want to use yours. If you decide to go this route, I cannot be responsible for lost packages and the like.
5. The buyer is responsible for all shipping costs. Note I do not charge any shipping fees, only postage.
6. Shipping is from 85387 (Surprise, AZ).
7. I will ship selectively worldwide. Contact me prior to bidding as there are certain countries that I will not ship to. Worldwide shipping is extremely expensive. I can provide anyone with a shipping quote so you will know how much it will cost. If you do not contact me prior to bidding, I reserve the right to cancel your bid. Additionally I am not going to do all the paperwork and stand in line at USPS for a $1.00 game. Sorry.
8. Local Pickup is available.
9. I do combined shipping on multiple wins.
10. Payment will be by Paypal or Money Order/Cashiers Check or Cash
11. Play Nice If you don't like something about the auction GM me, don't post it on my auction please. Just to see if you all are really reading my rules, the first person to post a comment with the phrase, "Yes I read your stinking rules" on my list will win ten Geek Gold, and the second person will win five. Everyone else who posts this message after that will receive one geek gold.
12. Your bid is a commitment to purchase. If you are unsure about the game or not able to afford it, then please don't bid. I also sell a lot of games on E-Bay and you wouldn't believe what happens to people after they bid on my items. I can't tell you how many people end up in the hospital, or are run over by a car or even die (although I am suspicious of this last excuse). I am pretty sure than none of these terrible things will befall you should you bid on my items.
